title: Puppet Theater Animation Director
description: The user directs a surreal puppet theater where a Venice mask floats as the narrator above a stage, while BrainStem and RiggedFigure perform choreographed dance sequences below. The user assigns animation clips to each performer, controls a shared energy pool that powers all animations, adjusts timing offsets, and can undo/redo any directorial decision while maintaining conservation of total animation energy across performers.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a puppet theater animation director. Load venice_mask.glb, BrainStem.glb, and RiggedFigure.glb using GLTFLoader from CDN. Place a dark stage platform (BoxGeometry) at y=0. Position BrainStem at x=-2 and RiggedFigure at x=2 on the stage. Float the venice_mask at y=3.5 center-stage, gently bobbing with a sine wave. Use AnimationMixer for each model. Camera at z=7, y=2.5 looking at origin. Add warm SpotLight from above and dim ambient light for theatrical mood. Implement these interactions: (1) A shared energy pool of 100 units displayed as an HTML bar at top. (2) Left panel with sliders to allocate energy to BrainStem (0-100) and RiggedFigure (0-100); their sum must never exceed 100 (conservation law). Energy allocation controls animation timeScale proportionally (0 energy = paused, 50 = normal, 100 = double speed). (3) Clicking each performer cycles through their available animation clips. (4) A timing offset slider (-2s to +2s) per performer that shifts their animation start via mixer.time. (5) Clicking the venice_mask toggles a global slow-motion modifier (0.5x) that scales all timeScales while preserving energy ratios. (6) A color picker per performer that sets emissive tint on their materials. (7) Keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Z for undo and Ctrl+Y for redo, maintaining a history stack of all state changes (energy allocation, clip selection, timing offset, slow-motion toggle, color changes). Each undo/redo must restore the full coupled state atomically. (8) The venice_mask rotates to face whichever performer has more energy allocated, lerping smoothly. Display current state info in an overlay. Use requestAnimationFrame loop updating all three mixers with delta time multiplied by respective energy-derived timeScales and the global slow-motion modifier.
